article.title: Gathering Forces: Election Defense In Authoritarian Times
article.author: Marcy Rein
article.content: As voter suppression ramps up and election sabotage starts to play out, democracy defenders are strategizing in and across sectors and geographies, breaking silos between electoral work, community defense, and mutual aid. They’re preparing to defend voters, the election process, and if needed, the election results–even as they gear up to turn out an anti-authoritarian vote too big to be denied. Source
